description.en:
Xialan S02 is Digit Robotics' humanlike interaction robot for reception, guided explanations and customer-facing communication. Its presentation emphasizes a lifelike face and coordinated speech, expression and gesture so that information can be delivered through a recognizable social character.

The manufacturer describes camera and microphone inputs for face tracking, sound localization and multi-turn dialogue, with mobile operation for configured indoor environments. Applications include exhibition interpretation, business inquiries and promotional engagement. Appearance and interaction content can be adapted for a venue. The public page mixes S02 and S01 wording, so version-specific mechanical specifications require confirmation.
description.zh: 以自然人体比例、仿生表情和多模态交流为核心的人形交互机器人，面向迎宾、导览、业务咨询和展项讲解等场景。
